newTransport: Paseo chunk RPC, opaque IDs; no Cindy cloud endpoint or credentials
hostAdaptations: Opaque group-owned UUIDs replace cloud media IDs/URLs; bytes use inert .bin names, fixed 393216-byte chunks, immutable SHA-256 metadata and group-scoped access checks.
All media refs, outbox receipts and group messages share CompanionStore.transaction; staged data is fsynced before its durable cursor.
Explicit queued/unknown states and operation receipts distinguish durable local reception from native execution; no idle inference or alternate native send fallback.
Failed-entry edit atomically returns attachment ownership to staging and tombstones the old outbox identity; discard releases only its own refs.
Cindy production rejects empty media; this adapter preserves that rule as MEDIA_EMPTY.
Native file/image inputs are not connected in this slice: ATTACHMENT_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE is emitted before creating or sending to a model. Thread replies remain text-only.
